data.title: 一色彩羽 · 走廊小跑追赶的娇嗔鼓腮·「八幡前辈！走太快了啦，等等我！」
data.description: 【总武高夕阳走廊·放学后】抱着一沓学生会文件的彩羽一路小跑追赶。文件挡在胸前，两只脚丫在地板上踏出清脆声响。追上你之后她微微喘息，有些生气地鼓起腮帮子仰视，蜜茶色双马尾随步伐跳动，可爱得令人心动。
data.location: 总武高中教学楼黄昏走廊
data.action: 小跑追赶手抱文件喘息，鼓腮娇嗔仰视，百褶裙轻扬
data.lighting: 走廊一整排落地窗透入的橘红色斜阳
data.camera: medium shot, holding documents, running, pouting, hallway sunset
data.promptProse: Iroha Isshiki hurries down a polished wooden school hallway lined with tall windows at sunset, clutching a thick stack of student council printouts against her blazer. Coming to a quick stop, she breathes rapidly with puffed rosy cheeks, glaring upward in playful petulance as her low wavy twintails bounce against her shoulders. Golden hour sunlight bathes the entire corridor in rich amber and long purple shadows. Medium shot, energetic slice-of-life key visual style, detailed high school hallway background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
